parsed.production_notes: The ad uses a mixed-media approach. The top panel features a static, AI-generated image of a humanoid robot, while the bottom panel shows a live-action, human-recorded video of a young woman.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor quizzes a human learner, identifies a grammatical mistake in her English, and provides a live correction, followed by a Q&A to overcome her objections about the learning app.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Bengali between two characters. There is no background music until the final end card.

characters.appearance: An AI-generated female humanoid robot with a pale, synthetic face, blue eyes, and no hair, revealing a metallic head structure. Her neck and upper torso show exposed mechanical parts, while the chest and shoulders are covered in smooth, white plating. She resembles the real-world robot Sophia.
characters.wardrobe: The character is a robot and does not wear clothing. Its body is composed of white and silver metallic plating. Thin black wires, resembling earphone cables, run from its ears down its chest.
characters.demeanor: Calm, neutral, and authoritative, with a consistently placid facial expression.

characters.appearance: A young South Asian woman in her early to mid-20s, with a medium build and a warm brown complexion. She has dark, shoulder-length wavy hair, large expressive dark eyes, and a friendly face.
characters.wardrobe: A casual, short-sleeved olive green t-shirt and dark blue jeans. She wears a watch on her left wrist.
characters.demeanor: Expressive and relatable. She transitions from hesitant and frustrated about her English skills to curious, impressed, and hopeful.
